hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$f" ] && echo "$f" | grep -qE '\.(js|css)$' && printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"Note: %s was just modified.
